claim: The Halloween Zen Garden is a horned stone statue with glowing yellow eyes, wrapped in thorny vines and ringed by stepping stones. Villagers sit in front of it to meditate, as at an ordinary Zen Garden.

evidence.reference: Maintainer playtest of The Great Pumpkin Race, 8 November 2026, day 1.

notes: The map starts with one Zen Garden _Halloween (gameobject 105734) already placed.
